_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). Both declared tests MUST fail with AssertionErrors on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: without PUBLIC_ORIGIN, a forged Host header is returned as-is (host-header injection)
expectedRed.why: On correct code resolveOrigin must reject the forged host in production without PUBLIC_ORIGIN, so the assertion that the forged host is returned as-is fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the production origin guard is missing or was removed.

expectedRed.testName: validateRuntimeEnv does NOT throw when PUBLIC_ORIGIN is absent in production (no guard)
expectedRed.why: On correct code validateRuntimeEnv must throw when PUBLIC_ORIGIN is absent in production, so `expect(() => validateRuntimeEnv()).not.toThrow()` fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the startup guard is missing or was removed.
